name: promptimize
description: /promptimize: turn a rough prompt into an optimized one (small, medium or large) in a pane, after a short interview

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the prompt: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or a full model id. Empty: the model in your settings, else sonnet.

models.title: Extra models
models.description: More model ids for the picker, separated by commas.

includeContext.title: Include session context
includeContext.description: Tick "Include recent session context" by default. It costs tokens.
